headline: Six Fronts See Base Swaps as Casualties Mount
war_summary: Since the last edition three hours ago the war’s hottest sectors have deepened. Callahans Passage now tallies 12,714 Colonial and 14,644 Warden dead, 766 fresh enlistments and 69 ownership changes — five of them in the past two hours. Weathered Expanse adds 11,853 Colonial and 18,306 Warden casualties, 589 recruits and 24 base flips. Fishermans Row surges to 593 Colonial and 650 Warden losses, 287 new troops and 57 exchanges, six recorded in the last two hours. Stlican Shelf reports 3,895 Colonial and 3,774 Warden dead, 452 enlistees and 52 ownership shifts. Mooring County climbs to 3,705 Colonial and 3,953 Warden casualties, 622 recruits and 12 flips, five recent. Nevish Line reaches 6,487 Colonial and 6,506 Warden dead, 800 enlistments and 12 ownership changes, nine in the last two hours. The remaining regions show no base‑ownership movement and only modest casualty drift.
